title: The Pumbeditans Say

paragraphs: [Pesachim 104a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.104a.1). Rav Sheshet said to Rav Amram: “Perhaps you are from Pumbedita, where they pass an elephant through the eye of a needle” ([Bava Metzia 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.38b.16)). “The judges of Pumbedita” refers to Rav Papa bar Shmuel; “the Amoraim of Pumbedita,” to Rabbah and Rav Yosef; “the sharp ones of Pumbedita,” to Eifa and Avimi, the sons of Rechava; and “the elders of Pumbedita,” to Rav Yehudah and Rav Eina, as in [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5).[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Pesachim, the Pumbeditans say that the concluding blessing should echo its opening. The linked Sanhedrin gives the named groups of judges, sages and sharp scholars.
